title: Friends, right now the world feels like a blur of real suffering, fake videos, and manipulated feeds. From reports of protests cut off from the world to AI that makes lies look real — we must choose discernment and truth. Let’s not be swept up by deception or fear, but anchor ourselves in Christ who is the truth (John 14:6). Pray for justice, wisdom, and peace — share if you want a digital culture rooted in truth, not manipulation.
